title: Important Updates on Mark Price Calculation of TradFi Perpetual Contracts (2026-08-31)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance constantly reviews its product and service offerings to ensure the best user experience for all users. Effective from  2026-08-31 08:15 (UTC),  Binance Futures will make adjustments to mark price calculation of  TradFi Perpetual Contracts  by updating the basis of Price 2 from 30 seconds basis to 1 minute basis.  Futures Contracts Before the Adjustment After the Adjustment TradFi Perpetual Contracts Mark Price = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price)  Where Price 2 = Price Index + Moving Average (30 Seconds Basis)  Note: The Moving Average (30 Seconds Basis) is calculated as the average of 30 data points over a 30 seconds period. The basis is calculated every second by taking the average of the bid and ask prices and then subtracting the Price Index. Mark Price = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price)  Where Price 2 = Price Index + Moving Average (1-Minute Basis)  Note: The Moving Average (1-Minute Basis) is calculated as the average of 60 data points over a 1-minute period. The basis is calculated every second by taking the average of the bid and ask prices and then subtracting the Price Index. The moving average basis of Price 2 of  non-TradFi Perpetual Contracts remains unchanged  at a 30 seconds basis. Notes: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
